title: 第19章 至枉安城第20章 加入学院
content_zh:
望着牧帆的身影消失在眼底。
牧族的人皆是五味杂陈，回想着刚刚发生的一切，感觉很不真实。
牧帆，那个少年至尊，真的回来了，并且以更强的姿态！
可惜，牧帆已经和牧族没有任何关系！
牧海雄脸色阴沉，“牧帆这小子，忘恩负义！”
“本长老早就知道，这小子不是什么好东西！”
三长老愤愤说道。
……
牧帆直接离开了清风城。
年轻英俊的面庞，少了几分稚嫩，眼神显得有些深邃。
这一年多的时间，他经历可以说是丰富了！
沦为废人，受尽嘲讽，如今重回巅峰，还成功报了仇。
牧帆学会了很多，尤其是心性上的提升！
午时，来到一处小镇。
牧帆决定在此休息一晚上。
于是来到一间客栈前。
客栈分两楼，一楼是吃饭的地方，摆着好几套桌椅，二楼则是睡觉的地方。
牧帆走了进去，朝着柜台前是老板娘说道：“住一晚。”
“好的公子，住一晚是两块灵石，吃饭来一楼点，费用另算。”
老板娘笑着脸庞，显得很热情。

牧帆交了两枚灵石，拿到房间钥匙便上了二楼。
房间很整洁宽敞。
牧帆先是将夺来的储物灵戒都拿出来，以灵气将上面的灵魂印记磨灭，随后将里面的东西都打理好，没有用的则是直接扔了。
毕竟都是玄武境高手，又是有身份的人，储物灵戒中的东西都很多，灵石、丹药什么的都有。
牧帆把珍贵的东西都收集到自己的储物灵戒中。
然后又将生活用品放入另外一枚灵戒内。
这些储物灵戒，品质都差不多，内部空间基本没有太大的区别。
收拾好之后，牧帆找来一个木盆，舒舒服服的洗了个热水澡，换了一身白衣，便是直接躺在床榻上大睡起来。
这几个月以来，他的精神随时处于高度紧张的状态，需要好好休息一晚上。
虽然修炼会给身体带来好处，但是境界毕竟还没那么高，适当的放松休息是很有必要的。
……
关于清风城中发生的大事，消息迅速传遍整个清风城，随后是附近的村镇……
萧钟的身份也被传出，萧家最强大的两位玄武境九重之一！
牧帆之名，彻底被传开。
“不得了啊，这牧帆先灭范城林家，然后是清风城宋家，牧族听说也被杀了不少人，再加上一个萧钟，前前后后杀了好几位玄武境的大高手！”
“就连自己的族人都杀，这牧帆不会是走火入魔了吧？”
“听说了吗？牧帆走火入魔了。”
“我听说牧帆修炼魔功，见人就杀，还吸人血呢！”
“……”
消息越传越邪乎。

……
次日清晨。
牧帆打着哈切走下二楼，独自一人坐到角落位置，点了些饭菜吃。
content_en:
Watching Mu Fan's figure disappear from his eyes.
The people of the herdsman tribe all had mixed emotions. Thinking back on what had just happened, they felt very unreal.
Mu Fan, that boy supreme, is really back, and in a stronger form!
It's a pity that Mufan no longer has any relationship with the Mu clan!
Mu Haixiong's face was gloomy, "Mu Fan, that kid is ungrateful!"
"This elder has known for a long time that this boy is not a good person!"
The third elder said angrily.
…
Mufan left Qingfeng City directly.
The young and handsome face is a little less immature, and his eyes are a little deep.
In more than a year, his experience can be said to be rich!
He was reduced to a useless person and was ridiculed. Now he is back at the top and has successfully taken revenge.
Mufan learned a lot, especially the improvement of his character!
At noon, we came to a small town.
Mufan decided to rest here for the night.
So I came to an inn.
The inn is divided into two floors. The first floor is a dining area with several sets of tables and chairs, and the second floor is a sleeping area.
Mu Fan walked in and said to the proprietress in front of the counter, "Stay one night."
"Okay, sir, it's two spiritual stones for one night's stay. For meals, come to the first floor. The cost is extra."
The lady boss smiled and looked very enthusiastic.
Mufan handed over two spirit stones, got the room key and went up to the second floor.
The room was very clean and spacious.
Mu Fan first took out all the stolen storage spirit rings, used spiritual energy to erase the soul marks on them, and then took care of everything inside, throwing away the useless ones.
After all, they are both Xuanwu Realm masters and people with status. There are many things in the storage ring, including spiritual stones, elixirs and so on.
Mufan collected all the precious things into his storage ring.
Then he put daily necessities into another spiritual ring.
These storage rings are all of similar quality, and there is basically no big difference in the internal space.
After cleaning up, Mu Fan found a wooden basin, took a comfortable hot bath, changed into white clothes, and then lay down on the bed and fell asleep.
In the past few months, his spirit has been in a state of high tension at all times and he needs a good night's rest.
Although cultivation will bring benefits to the body, the level is not that high after all, and proper relaxation and rest are necessary.
…
Regarding the major events that occurred in Qingfeng City, news quickly spread throughout Qingfeng City, followed by nearby villages and towns...
Xiao Zhong's identity was also revealed, one of the two most powerful people in the Xiao family, ninth level of Xuanwu Realm!
Mufan's name was completely spread.
"It's incredible. Mu Fan first destroyed the Lin family in Fan City, and then the Song family in Qingfeng City. I heard that many people from the Mu Fan family were also killed. Plus Xiao Zhong, he killed several great masters in the Xuanwu Realm!"
"Even if he kills his own clansmen, is this Mu Fan going crazy?"
"Have you heard? Mufan has gone crazy."
"I heard that Mu Fan practices magic, kills people on sight, and even sucks people's blood!"
"..."
The more the news spreads, the more evil it becomes.
…
Early next morning.
Mu Fan followed Ha Qie down to the second floor, sat alone in a corner, and ordered some food to eat.
